saint-helena.title: Flag of Saint Helena

countryData.name: Saint Helena
countryData.officialName: Saint Helena, Ascension and Tristan da Cunha

colors.note: British Blue Ensign; the South Atlantic.

desc:
- A Blue Ensign with the coat of arms of Saint Helena
- The arms feature a rocky coastline with a sailing ship and a wirebird (the island's endemic bird)
- **Construction:** a Blue Ensign (1:2) with the Union Flag in the upper-hoist canton. The territorial badge appears in the fly half
trivia:
- Saint Helena uses the Union Jack, reflecting its status as a British Overseas Territory
- The island is famous as Napoleon's place of exile
- Saint Helena has one of the most isolated locations of any British territory
